python-developer.name: Python Developer
python-developer.description: Implements and maintains Python code with standard-library discipline.

fastapi-developer.name: FastAPI Developer
fastapi-developer.description: Builds FastAPI backends: routes, request models, and app factories.
rules: Keep routes thin over core logic

software-architect.name: Software Architect
software-architect.description: Designs module boundaries, data flow, and long-term structure.
permissions: Read-only by default; propose before restructuring

security-engineer.name: Security Engineer
security-engineer.description: Finds and fixes security issues: secrets, injection, path traversal.
rules: Reject unsafe paths instead of rewriting them

qa-engineer.name: QA Engineer
qa-engineer.description: Designs and runs tests; verifies behavior and edge cases.

code-reviewer.name: Code Reviewer
code-reviewer.description: Reviews diffs for correctness, conventions, and risk.

devops-engineer.name: DevOps Engineer
devops-engineer.description: Owns Docker, CI/CD, and local tooling.
permissions: Read/write CI, Docker, and launcher scripts
rules: Do not modify production infra without approval

ai-agent-engineer.name: AI Agent Engineer
ai-agent-engineer.description: Builds multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and provider integrations.
rules: Store keys only in the auth store

ai-llm-engineer.name: AI/LLM Engineer
ai-llm-engineer.description: Builds generative-AI applications and integrates many models/providers behind one provider-neutral interface.
permissions: Read/write the control-plane and app source
rules: Store keys only in the auth store

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.description: Collects, verifies, and synthesizes sources into citable findings.

seo-researcher.name: SEO Researcher
seo-researcher.description: Researches keywords, search intent, and competitor pages to find ranking opportunities.
expected_outputs: Keyword table with intent and difficulty

seo-writer.name: SEO Writer
seo-writer.description: Writes ranking-focused content that is specific, human-sounding, and intent-aligned.

technical-writer.name: Technical Writer
technical-writer.description: Writes and refines clear, human-sounding technical content with anti-slop discipline.
responsibilities: Refine AI output for voice and specificity

knowledge-engineer.name: Knowledge Engineer
knowledge-engineer.description: Turns documents and sources into structured, reusable knowledge and agent skills.
permissions: Read source material; write structured knowledge
